key_insight: Integrating LLM guidance with numerical optimization can accelerate simulation-based redesign and increase the likelihood of finding near-optimal solutions.
engineering_relevance: LLMs can use engineering context and changed requirements to guide costly simulator-based searches when adapting an existing design.
method: Compare three LLM integration strategies: warm start, variable fixing, and ReAct.
Pair LLM guidance with Bayesian optimization, genetic algorithms, mesh adaptive direct search, and random search.
Evaluate electric vehicle battery pack cost minimization across four types of redesign scenarios.
evidence_signal: In the battery pack case study, the integrated approach matched baseline feasible-design discovery with 80% fewer simulator evaluations while tripling the fraction of runs finding near-optimal solutions.
watch_item: The best integration strategy depended on the requirement change, so performance gains should not be assumed to transfer unchanged to other redesign tasks.
